name: @jev-harness/omp
description: OMP-native adapter: Jev (System One) tools and opt-in auto-hooks for Oh My Pi.

envDocs.TYPESAFE_API_KEY: Required. System One API key. Never hardcoded, never logged.
envDocs.JEV_TIMEOUT_MS: Override. Per-request timeout in ms. Default 15000.
envDocs.OMP_JEV_AUTO: Master switch for all auto hooks. Set to 1 to enable.
envDocs.OMP_JEV_GATE: tool_call destructive gate off-switch. Set to 0 to disable (default enabled when OMP_JEV_AUTO=1).
envDocs.OMP_JEV_SKILL_ROUTER: input skill-suggestion off-switch. Set to 0 to disable.
envDocs.OMP_JEV_CONTEXT: session_before_compact verbatim-compaction off-switch. Set to 0 to disable.
envDocs.OMP_JEV_KEEP_THRESHOLD: Keep probability threshold for compaction. Default 0.2.
envDocs.OMP_JEV_TRUNCATE_HEAD: Kept head chars for truncated tool results. Default 300.
envDocs.OMP_JEV_MIN_REDUCTION: Minimum saved/total char ratio before returning a compaction. Default 0.25.
envDocs.OMP_JEV_MAX_CALLS_PER_MIN: Rolling per-minute cap on Jev requests across tools and hooks. Default 120. Set to 0 to disable the cap.
envDocs.OMP_JEV_CACHE_DIR: Directory for the cross-session judgment cache. Default ~/.omp/cache/jev-harness.
envDocs.OMP_JEV_CACHE_TTL_MS: How long a cached judgment stays valid, in ms. Default 86400000 (1 day).
envDocs.OMP_JEV_DECISION_LOG: Path to a JSONL file to append every gate decision to. Unset keeps decisions in memory only.
envDocs.OMP_JEV_REDACT: 1 redacts secrets in ALL state, 0 disables redaction everywhere. Unset redacts hook state only; tools send full fidelity.
